subject: 北岳庙 · 德宁之殿正立面（含回廊、台基）
caption: 曲阳 · 北岳庙德宁之殿
元代木构 · 重檐庑殿
source_note: ScareCriterion12于2020年拍摄德宁之殿正面。省文物局简介称1347年建，曲阳县方志记1270年完工，北京旅游网记1270初建、1347重建；保留差异，采用元代且yearApprox=true，不将北魏建庙年当作现殿年。绘图含外围回廊九间，避免把殿身七间与总面阔混淆。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one architectural heritage illustration for 访古. Image 1 is ONLY the STYLE MASTER, the existing Vairocana contour drawing. Image 2 and any further images are actual monument photographs and ONLY define subject geometry. Match the master's delicate, slightly organic thin black contours, sparse interior strokes, generous white surfaces and restrained visual density. Pure BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. No black fills, shading, gray wash, hatching, pencil texture, dense brick or tile grids, color, text, labels, watermark or borders. Structural bays, eaves and silhouette must match the real monument. Reduce repetitive detail; do not trace every roof tile or brick. Openings stay white inside fine outlines. Complete apex and full base uncut, generous margins, centered near-frontal, reduced perspective. Remove tourists, trees, vegetation, fences, wires, vehicles, signs and surrounding modern structures. Ground consists of a few thin strokes. SUBJECT: Dening Hall of Beiyue Temple in Quyang, Hebei, the surviving Yuan dynasty great hall. Landscape 1536x1024. Match this exact symmetric photograph from the front: very broad monumental TWO-EAVED HIPPED ROOF (wudian, NOT a gabled xieshan roof), tall wide upper roof, lower surrounding veranda eave, nine-bay total front including the side veranda bays, inner hall seven-bay rhythm. High stone terrace with railings and one central broad straight stair leading to the middle door. Copy actual column placement and roof curvature carefully; both whole sweeping roof tips and terrace corners in frame. Keep both layers of bracket sets as delicate selective outlines, large white roof planes and wall panels, no dense tiles. Preserve the large curved ridge-end ornaments as outline silhouettes. Remove gold foreground incense burner, small freestanding stele in front, trees/bushes, surrounding scenery, sky, all plaques and inscription lettering. Do not add extra roofs, auxiliary halls or extra side staircases. Show the full central staircase, raised terrace, veranda columns, central doorway, two complete roofs and ridge. Spacious quiet detailed contours consistent with the Buddha style master.

site_recommendation.name: 北岳庙
site_recommendation.sub: 德宁之殿正立面（含回廊、台基）
site_recommendation.yearNote: 省文物局以至正七年1347列现殿；县方志有至元七年1270完工记载，需并记营建阶段。
site_recommendation.lede: 北岳庙的德宁之殿坐在高台上，两重庑殿檐口横向舒展。它曾是皇家遥祭北岳恒山的场所，元代木构、壁画与历代祭祀碑刻共同保存了这处古岳庙的记忆。

facts.label: 年代
facts.text: 现殿属元代，资料分别记1270年营建完成与1347年重建，年表以元代约值登记。

facts.label: 殿宇
facts.text: 重檐庑殿顶，周设回廊，整体面阔九间、进深六间，中央踏道登上高台。

facts.label: 祭祀
facts.text: 北岳庙原为遥祭恒山的神庙，殿内保存元代壁画，院中汇集历代碑刻。

quality_check.notes: 核对双重庑殿屋顶、九间总立面、完整回廊台基与中央阶梯；屋面保持留白。
